summary: Legacy Housing Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, scheduled for October 28, 2026, as a virtual meeting, with a record date of September 14, 2026. The filing also discloses revised deadlines for stockholder proposals (September 4, 2026) and nominations (August 24, 2026) under Rule 14a-8. This is a routine administrative notice required because the meeting date changed by more than 30 days from the prior year's meeting. No special-situation transaction or corporate event is involved, so the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
